title: 第23章 金色词条万界唯我第24章 未来的隐忧
content_zh:
‘我好像已经看到未来的对手了。’
待听到“诸国天骄榜”时，叶离心中暗暗想道。
按照一般套路，在这种古代都有权威机构定制的榜单。
里面详细的描述了这世界的战力前列档次。
然后就是主角千辛万苦地爬天梯，一个个打上去直到第一。
显然，这“诸国天骄榜”，应该就是如此。
叶离自认为，既然自己拥有鸣人的身世！郑扎的智慧！路明非的气魄……
‘上述这些主角特质融为一体，那我应该算是主角了！这天骄榜，也不得不上了。’
似是注意到叶离的目光，冯越也注意到远处吆喝卖书的少年，笑道：
“你之前一直生活在南区，这天骄榜应该没怎么听过吧。”
叶离老实承认：“确实是第一次听到。”
见叶离不懂，冯越笑道：“这天骄榜，其实是中州的大庆王朝中‘司天监’按橙色史诗词条【追因溯果】所设榜单。”
“传说这【追因溯果】可以探查大庆境内的万物，便是武圣，踏入大庆境内的第一时间也会被卜算到。”
“相传整个大庆境内的所有橙色以下词条，都在【追因溯果】的监控之中！就连觉醒每个词条种类的人数都能监察出来。”
“这么恐怖！”叶离倒吸一口凉气：“那岂不是一点隐秘都没了。”
冯越感慨道：“当然，这可是有记录以来最强的情报类词条！”
“当年大庆开国太祖，拥有金色词条，同阶无双，一双铁臂打得八荒四海无一合敌，但若没有这词条辅佐，也难在中州立国！”
“中州三国，南蛮众派、北境千宗，西域万法，东海群妖，天外诸界，这可是每个地域的最强势力。”
见叶离一副一无所知的样子，冯越疑惑道：“你不是读过书吗，连这也不知道吗？”
“这我真不懂。”叶离无奈解释道：

“成年前读书是为了觉醒词条，私塾识字背完名篇，觉醒【机敏过人】前置以后，就去刷其他词条了，没精力了解这种。”
“等我18岁以后，一直练武到现在，全身心投入练武，那就更没有时间了解了。”
毕竟叶离之前经历的一直是填鸭的应试教育。
每天都在用力活着，真没有精力了解这些。
见叶离一副小白模样，冯越也没辙，将话题又拉了回来：
“像是刚才的诸国天骄榜，就是大庆撰写的，除天外众界，便是五域青年一辈最强。”
“就比如说，刚才那个纪询，就是青年一辈的第一，不仅年纪轻轻到了后天，更是有传说中的金色词条！”
“金色词条！！！”叶离闪过好奇。
“对啊。”冯越显然也是八卦老手了，开口流利地解释道：“那个词条叫【万界唯我】！”
“每过一载，便能强行收束自身，将天外众界里一个实力与自己相当的强者吞噬。”
“也就是说，每过一年，他的力量、资质、根基、天赋、经验、技巧就会在原有的基础上暴增一倍！”
叶离：“啊？？？”
叶离：这不就是...玄幻版本的，同时被99个世界穿越吗？
看着青年瞪大的眼睛，冯越得意一笑道：
“怎么样，厉害吧，那可是金色词条，咱们一辈子都不敢想的，只要活下来，武圣必成！”
“确实厉害。”叶离不得不承认。
对比起来，自己那看似炫彩的【惊世智慧】，效果就显得极为一般了，只是能没有任何瓶颈的突破而已。
他原以为，深蓝加点就已经天下无敌了，这【万界唯我】看起来更是强的不行。
content_en:
‘I seem to have seen my future opponent. ’
When he heard the "List of Prodigies of All Countries", Ye Li thought to himself.
According to the general routine, in ancient times, there were lists customized by authoritative organizations.
It describes in detail the top levels of combat power in this world.
Then the protagonist climbs the ladder with great difficulty, climbing up one by one until he reaches the first place.
Obviously, this "List of Prodigies of All Nations" should be like this.
Ye Li thinks that since he has Naruto's life experience! Zheng Zha’s wisdom! Lu Mingfei's courage...
‘If the above-mentioned protagonist characteristics are integrated into one, then I should be considered the protagonist! I have to be on this list of geniuses. ’
Seemingly noticing Ye Li's gaze, Feng Yue also noticed the boy selling books in the distance, and smiled:
"You have been living in the Southern District before, so you probably haven't heard much about the Talent List."
Ye Li admitted honestly: "This is indeed the first time I heard it."
Seeing that Ye Li didn't understand, Feng Yue smiled and said: "This list of geniuses is actually a list set up by the 'Si Tianjian' of the Daqing Dynasty in Zhongzhou according to the orange epic entry [Tracing Cause and Effect]."
"It is said that this [Tracing Cause and Effect] can detect everything in Daqing. Even the Martial Saint will be predicted the first time he steps into Daqing."
"It is said that all entries below orange in the entire Daqing are under the surveillance of [Chasing Cause and Effect]! Even the number of people who have awakened to each entry type can be monitored."
"So terrifying!" Ye Li took a breath: "That means there is no secret at all."
Feng Yue sighed: "Of course, this is the strongest intelligence entry ever recorded!"
"Back then, the founding ancestor of Daqing had a golden entry. He was unparalleled at the same level. With a pair of iron arms, he could defeat all enemies in the world. But without the help of this entry, it would be difficult to establish a country in Zhongda!"
"The three kingdoms of Zhongzhou, the southern barbarian sects, the thousands of sects in the north, the ten thousand sects in the western region, the demons in the east sea, and the outer worlds, these are the strongest forces in each region."
Seeing Ye Li's clueless look, Feng Yue asked doubtfully: "Haven't you read a book? Don't you even know this?"
"I really don't understand this." Ye Li explained helplessly:
"The purpose of studying before adulthood is to awaken the entries. I learned to read and memorize famous articles in private school. After awakening [Excellent Alertness], I started to read other entries. I didn't have the energy to understand this kind of thing."
"When I turn 18 and have been practicing martial arts until now and devote myself to practicing martial arts, I won't have time to understand."
After all, Ye Li had always experienced cramming and exam-oriented education.
I am working hard to live every day, and I really don’t have the energy to understand these things.
Seeing that Ye Li looked like a novice, Feng Yue had no choice but to bring the topic back:
"For example, the list of geniuses from all countries just now was written by Daqing. In all realms except heaven, it is the young generation from the five regions who are the strongest."
"For example, Ji Xun just now is the number one among the young generation. Not only is he young enough to be the day after tomorrow, but he also has the legendary golden entry!"
"Golden entry!!!" Ye Li flashed with curiosity.
"That's right." Feng Yue was obviously a veteran of gossip, and he explained fluently: "That entry is called [Only Me in All Realms]!"
"Every year, he can forcibly restrain himself and devour a strong man in the outer world who is comparable to himself."
"In other words, with every passing year, his strength, qualifications, foundation, talent, experience, and skills will double on the original basis!"
Ye Li: "Ah???"
Ye Li: Isn't this...a fantasy version of being transported through 99 worlds at the same time?
Looking at the young man's wide eyes, Feng Yue smiled proudly and said:
"How about it? It's awesome. That's a golden entry. We never dare to think about it in our lifetime. As long as we survive, we will become a martial saint!"
"It's indeed amazing." Ye Li had to admit.
In comparison, the effect of my seemingly dazzling [Astonishing Wisdom] appears to be extremely ordinary. It can only break through without any bottlenecks.already.
He originally thought that if Deep Blue added a few points, he would be invincible, but this [All Realms Only Me] seemed to be even more powerful.
